meta.name: Full Circle with Michael Palin
meta.description: Michael Palin travels to 18 countries around the rim of the Pacific Ocean.

videos.title: Alaska and Russia
videos.overview: Michael Palin travels around the Pacific rim. He starts in the Diomede Islands in the Bering Strait, goes to see the Kodiak bear in Alaska and visits the geysers and hot springs of Kamchatka.

videos.title: Japan and Korea
videos.overview: In this episode Michael Palin samples the oddity of Oriental life while passing through Japan and South Korea.

videos.title: China
videos.overview: Michael Palin enters China by boat from Korea. He visits the cities of Qingdao and Shanghai and takes a local steamer down the Yangtze.

videos.title: Vietnam and the Philippines
videos.overview: Michael Palin visits Hanoi, takes a sampan on the Perfume River, witnesses psychic surgery, sees the Cu Chi tunnels, judges a beauty contest and fails to see the Banaue rice terraces.

videos.title: Borneo and Java
videos.overview: From the Philippines, Michael Palin crosses the Sulu sea in a leaky ferry. He travels on through the Borneo jungle to Java where he climbs a volcano.

videos.title: Australia and New Zealand
videos.overview: Michael Palin reaches Australia where his activities include a cameo role in Home and Away. He also looks for sperm whales in New Zealand's icy waters.

videos.title: Chile and Bolivia
videos.overview: Michael Palin lands on Cape Horn, parties on Chiloé, visits Santiago, the Juan Fernández Islands and La Paz, and crosses the Andes by a train which is derailed.

videos.title: Bolivia and Peru
videos.overview: Michael Palin takes a reed boat on Lake Titicaca in the Andes, before an 1,000 mile journey along the Urubamba river to the Amazon.

videos.title: Peru and Colombia
videos.overview: From a canoe in the Peruvian rainforest, Michael Palin visits Machiguenga Indian villages in one of remotest spots on planet. He then he sails down Amazon on a restored riverboat.

videos.title: Mexico, USA, Canada and Alaska
videos.overview: Michael Palin travels from Mexico City to the Diomede Islands where his trek began. He meets up with illegal immigrants in Mexico, cruises San Francisco's gay scene and visits Alcatraz.

videos.title: Interview with Michael Palin
videos.overview: Michael Palin discusses the difficulties in shooting "Full Circle."

videos.title: Deleted Scenes and Outtakes
videos.overview: Humorous and interesting outtakes from Michael Palin's journey in "Full Circle."
